profile_text.body:
Credo AI is an AI governance software company founded in 2020. Its site describes it as the creator of the AI governance category and says the platform lets enterprises discover their AI, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, applications, and vendors. The company says the platform is built on a knowledge graph that combines regulatory intelligence with a customer's own business context, and that it is supported by forward-deployed governance experts.

The product is the Credo AI platform, listed in the AI governance and risk management category and described as purpose-built AI governance with policy packs for the EU AI Act and the NIST AI RMF, a clean interface, and fast deployment. The site also names GAIA (Govern AI Assistant), which it says is generally available in the platform, and policy packs covering the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. Credo AI says it offers agent governance with a registry for every agent, native integrations across a customer's existing stack, and that its policy packs were written by a team involved in ISO, NIST, the EU Parliament, NATO, and OECD work. Testimonials on the site come from Mastercard and reference a collaboration with IBM on Compliance Accelerators; one customer states that working with the platform accelerated EU AI Act compliance by at least 10x the speed of doing it manually.
